types.name: PwGenError
types.description:
Last error of the PwGen facade.
The predeclared instance `PwGenError` tracks the current error. `Snapshot` copies it into `tPwGenError` before the next operation overwrites it.

### Notes
- There is no `SetError` on this class.
- Getters read the last-error store. A `tPwGenError` value holds its own copy.

### Example
```basic
pw = PwGen.Generate(opts)
If PwGenError.HasError Then Debug.Print PwGenError.ToString()
```

members.name: Clear
members.signature: Public Sub Clear()
members.description:
Clears this error.
Clears the last-error store.

### Syntax
`PwGenError.Clear`

members.name: Code
members.signature: Public Property Get Code() As String
members.description:
Machine-readable error code.

### Return value
A code such as `EmptyCharset`, or an empty string when `HasError` is false.

members.name: HasError
members.signature: Public Property Get HasError() As Boolean
members.description:
True when an error is present.
The predeclared instance reads the last-error store.

### Syntax
`ok = Not PwGenError.HasError`

### Return value
`True` if this instance currently holds an error; otherwise `False`.

members.name: Message
members.signature: Public Property Get Message() As String
members.description:
Human-readable message for this error.

### Return value
The message text, or an empty string when `HasError` is false.

members.name: New
members.signature: Private Sub New()
members.description: Blocks external construction. The predeclared instance is the only instance.

members.name: Origin
members.signature: Public Property Get Origin() As String
members.description:
Origin of the operation that produced this error.

### Return value
`CurrentComponentName.CurrentProcedureName` of the public entry, e.g. `PwGen.Generate`, or an empty string when `HasError` is false.

members.name: Snapshot
members.signature: Public Function Snapshot() As tPwGenError
members.description:
Snapshot of the current error.
The next facade call does not change this value.

### Syntax
`snap = PwGenError.Snapshot()`

### Return value
A `tPwGenError` with its own fields, independent of the last-error store.

members.name: ToString

members.description:
One-line summary for logs.

### Syntax
`text = PwGenError.ToString()`

### Return value
Empty when `HasError` is false; otherwise `Origin: Code - Message`.

types.name: PwGenOptions
types.description:
Per-call options for password generation.
The predeclared instance is a factory (`Alphanumeric`, `Complex`, `Passphrase`, `Pin`, `Hex`), not shared mutable state.

### Notes
- `PwGenOptions.Alphanumeric` starts from the everyday random defaults.
- Do not set properties on `PwGenOptions` itself; use a preset or `Clone` first.
- Validation runs in `PwGen.Generate` / `Entropy`, not in setters.

### Example
```basic
Dim o As PwGenOptions = PwGenOptions.Complex
o.Length = 20
Debug.Print PwGen.Generate(o)
```

Class, include/exclude, ambiguous, and `MinPerClass` settings do not apply. `StartsWithLetter` and `HasNoConsecutiveRepeats` still apply, to this pool.

types.name: PwGenRandom
types.description:
Injectable RNG: uniform integer in a closed interval.
`Nothing` on `PwGenOptions.RandomSource` selects the built-in CNG source.

### Syntax
`n = src.NextInRange(lowerBound, upperBound)`

### Parameters
- `lowerBound`, `upperBound`: inclusive; `lowerBound` must be `<= upperBound`.

### Return value
An integer `n` with `lowerBound <= n <= upperBound`.
